'''2017 MPC Chris Kelly LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Kelly]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
